BRIEFING AUDITS (D36). A research briefing is a RECORD - dated, frozen, correctly never edited - so its recommendations live in prose that nothing counts. This records, per briefing, that its numbered recommendations were audited against OPEN_ITEMS.json and what came of them. The gate does not parse the prose; it requires the audit to have been DONE. An unaudited briefing FAILS the andon.
